predictions.articleTitle: Iceland vs Luxembourg Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Can Depleted Visitors Break Through?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Iceland hold a decisive structural and personnel edge to secure a clean-sheet Home Win against a scoreless, midfield-depleted Luxembourg side.
possibilityAssessment: Iceland Home Win anchored by 2.40 goals per match and four clean sheets in five games against a depleted visitor (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals and 2:0 correct score supported by a 2.30 combined lambda and Luxembourg's four-match scoring drought (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Draw-Win HT/FT contingency if Dirk Carlson's defensive return stalls Iceland's attack before half-time (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: In-form Iceland attack faces scoreless, midfield-depleted Luxembourg in Group C4 finale.

spf.comment: Iceland's 2.40 goals-per-game attack, 0.20 concession rate, and 3:0 reverse-fixture dominance point cleanly to a 2:0 or 3:0 home victory against depleted Luxembourg.

over_under.comment: With aligned xG unavailable, a 2.30 goal-based lambda total (59.6% Under 2.5 in Poisson) and Luxembourg's four-match goalless run favor Under 2.5.

score.comment: 2:0 leads the 20.1% Poisson peak under home game management, while 3:0 captures Iceland's 100% rate of winning Group C4 fixtures by three-plus goals.

goals.comment: 2 goals (26.5%) and 3 goals (20.3%) represent the two highest-density outcomes around Iceland's 2.00 home lambda and Luxembourg's 0.30 away lambda.

bqc.comment: Iceland led at half-time in four of five group games while Luxembourg trailed and lost in four of five, with Draw-Win covering a compact first half.
